[EN] Ksharans...why does it always have to be ksharans? And how do you even pronounce it?

Doesn't matter. What matters is this: their mercenary berserkers have a core of darkness where we all have a heart. Bring me them.

My ex-wife was heartless. Wonder if she was really a ksharan?
[ES] Ksharans... ¿por qué siempre tienen que ser ksharans? ¿Y cómo se supone que se pronuncia?

No importa. Lo que importa es esto: sus mercenarios berserkers tienen un core of darkness donde todos tenemos un corazón. Tráemelos.

Mi exmujer no tenía corazón. Me pregunto si en realidad era una ksharan.

[EN] Great, . I think I have a clever use for these.
[ES] Genial, . Creo que se me ocurre un uso inteligente para esto.

[EN] I don't like fighting ksharans either. Their strange consonant clusters disturb me.
[ES] Tampoco me gusta pelear con ksharans. Sus extraños cúmulos de consonantes me perturban.
